[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 240
- Description: Fix Discord per-channel memory loss + parity guard (thread 29235)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/442
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1097
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/448
  
  Details:
  ## Summary
  Diagnosed and fixed the "missing memory between messages in the same Discord channel" bug, deployed and live-verified the fix, then closed the class-level gap with a parity guard test.
  
  ## Root cause
  `POST /chat-blocking` (`_chat_blocking_turn`) — the path the Discord adapter routes every channel message through — called `_log_session` only on its role-selection branches. The terminal branch that appended the real user + assistant turns set `_sessions[session_id]` in memory and returned WITHOUT writing to disk. The streaming path (`_stream_chat`, used by the Telegram adapter) DID persist. Net effect: every Discord channel transcript on disk stayed at `message_count == 1`, so an adapter restart (reload-from-disk) handed the next message an empty history.
  
  ## Changes
  1. **truesight_autopilot#442** — fix: `/chat-blocking` now persists via `_log_session` after each tool round and on the terminal branch (parity with `_stream_chat`) + `tests/test_chat_blocking_persistence.py` (red-on-bug/green-on-fix).
  2. **agentic_ai_context#1097** — filed the parity-gap follow-up in OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md (## Pending) to capture the class of bug.
  3. **truesight_autopilot#448** — parity guard: `tests/test_chat_persist_parity.py` drives BOTH `/chat` and `/chat-blocking`, asserts each persists the user + assistant turn, and asserts both survive a simulated restart. Locks the invariant so a future refactor that drops a `_log_session` call on either caller fails CI.
  
  ## Deploy + live verification
  - Box HEAD `b9bf9a49` contains the fix; service restarted 2026-09-14 09:04 UTC.
  - Live proof: Discord channel `1548885989412573235` session file `ebb51488db13.json` went from `message_count: 1` (pre-fix) to **66 messages, 8 user turns retained**.
  - Regression guard: Telegram session still growing (streaming path unaffected).
  - CI: smoke + tests green on all merged PRs; new tests pass locally (compileall/ruff/ruff-format/pytest).
  
  ## Evidence
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/442
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1097
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/448
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 400.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
